verdict.rationale: The Wyoming Secretary of State portal supports one-off online filings, such as the Annual Report Wizard, and offers an electronic annual-report reminder. A reminder notification is an adjacent feature, not a user-defined recurring job or workflow schedule, and no documented API or automation surface was found. Scheduling recurring filings is a plausible capability for a business-filing service, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence the product delivers it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
